correctness.rationale: The signed image recurrence \(W_{k+1}=W_kW_k(-W_k)\) gives unit total signed weight and exact prefix extrema \(M_k=k+1\), \(m_k=\min(0,2-k)\), checked from the initial state. Because each factor of length \(n\le3^k\) meets no more than two aligned kth substitution blocks, all possible sign choices are bounded by the prefix-extrema inequalities, yielding \(|S|\le2k+1\), including the \(k=0\) boundary. The factor 01 supplies adjacent opposite blocks; choosing a maximizing prefix makes a length-\(3^k\) factor with signed weight \(-(2k+1)\). Complement closure supplies \(+(2k+1)\), and sliding windows realize all intermediary Parikh counts, hence exactly \(2k+2\). These steps give the all-length sharp logarithmic envelope. Extracted standalone verify.py passed 177147 digit-formula comparisons, supertile extrema through \(k=8\), exact scale complexity through \(k=7\), and all 300 short-length bound tests. Finite checks are supplementary to the arbitrary-k proof.

value.rationale: The exact closed value \(\rho(3^k)=2k+2\) for every k and the sharp all-length geometric-scale envelope identify the true logarithmic coefficient in a binary morphic example lying in the \(d=1\), \(\Delta>0\) regime whose general 2013 classification only yields \(O(\log n)\) and asks for lower logarithmic growth. The map is a canonical, naturally parameterized special case of a 2026 family and a simple ternary digit-parity automatic word. The proof supplies an explicit prefix-extrema mechanism and infinitely many equality cases, not a finite sample, unmotivated parameter slice, known-table recomputation or mere substitution of general logarithmic estimates.
